Das Experiment

The enemy has developed a new weapon. She is sent behind enemy lines to destroy it and rescue several soldiers held captive for their experiments.

But when she is captured, she becomes their next test subject. They will push her limits and test her resistance to the breaking point.

Will they break her?

﻿

48 page comic by Sedna Studio.
